## Glossary of Terms Used In Response
- **Dead Code**: Functionality present in source file(s), however not actively utilized anywhere else in the program flow; typically results from past experiments abandoned mid-development or failed migration efforts leaving vestigial remnants behind.
- **Duplicate**: Multiple occurrences of equivalent functionality expressed using syntactically differing forms; frequently introduced when copy/pasting sections from one area to another creating latent inconsistency traps waiting silently until discovered accidentally much later on.
- **Cyclomatic Complexity**: Quantitative measure reflecting number of linear independent paths traversable through given block of executable statements; higher numbers suggest greater difficulty understanding nuanced edge cases hidden beneath seemingly straightforward surface level appearance.
- **Risk Management Strategies**: Precautionary measures employed proactively mitigating uncertainty stemming from proposed modifications particularly targeting fragile zones prone to regressive failures requiring close supervision otherwise overlooked entirely under normal circumstances.
